rules.title: ReactDOM.render has been removed in React 19
rules.description: ReactDOM.render has been removed in React 19. Applications must migrate to createRoot from 'react-dom/client'.

rules.title: ReactDOM.hydrate has been removed in React 19
rules.description: ReactDOM.hydrate has been removed in React 19. Applications must migrate to hydrateRoot from 'react-dom/client'.

rules.title: ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode has been removed in React 19
rules.description: ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode has been removed in React 19. Use root.unmount() on the root created by createRoot.

remediation.summary: Call root.unmount() on the instance returned by createRoot instead of ReactDOM.unmountComponentAtNode.

rules.title: ReactDOM.findDOMNode has been removed in React 19
rules.description: ReactDOM.findDOMNode has been removed in React 19. Pass a ref directly to the underlying DOM node.

remediation.summary: Pass a DOM ref directly to the native element instead of calling ReactDOM.findDOMNode.

rules.title: React.PropTypes has been removed from core React in React 19
rules.description: Accessing PropTypes directly on React (React.PropTypes) has been removed. Use TypeScript or import PropTypes from the standalone 'prop-types' package.

remediation.summary: Import PropTypes from 'prop-types' or migrate components to TypeScript interfaces.
remediation.exampleAfter:
import PropTypes from 'prop-types';
MyComponent.propTypes = { name: PropTypes.string };

rules.title: Legacy string refs have been removed in React 19
rules.description: String refs (e.g. <input ref='myInput' />) are removed in React 19. Use callback refs or useRef / createRef.

remediation.summary: Replace string refs with useRef() hooks or callback refs.

rules.title: this.refs property access on class components has been removed in React 19
rules.description: Accessing this.refs on class components has been completely removed in React 19. Migrate to React.createRef().

remediation.summary: Replace this.refs with React.createRef() in class components or convert to function components with useRef().

rules.title: defaultProps on function components has been removed in React 19
rules.description: Defining defaultProps on function components is no longer supported in React 19. Use standard JavaScript default parameters in component arguments.

remediation.summary: Migrate defaultProps on function components to ES6 default parameter syntax.

rules.title: Legacy lifecycle methods (componentWillMount, componentWillReceiveProps, componentWillUpdate) removed
rules.description: Legacy class lifecycle methods without UNSAFE_ prefix have been removed in React 19. Migrate to componentDidMount / componentDidUpdate or React Hooks.

remediation.summary: Migrate legacy lifecycles to componentDidMount, componentDidUpdate, or convert class to a function component with useEffect.

rules.title: Legacy Context API (contextTypes, childContextTypes) has been removed in React 19
rules.description: The legacy Context API using contextTypes and childContextTypes has been completely removed in React 19. Use React.createContext() and the use() hook.

remediation.summary: Migrate legacy contextTypes to React.createContext() and the use(Context) hook.

rules.title: React.createFactory has been removed in React 19
rules.description: React.createFactory was deprecated in older versions and is completely removed in React 19. Use standard JSX elements.

remediation.summary: Replace React.createFactory invocations with direct JSX elements.
remediation.exampleBefore:
const button = React.createFactory('button');
return button({ onClick }, 'Click');

rules.title: react-test-renderer/shallow has been removed in React 19
rules.description: react-test-renderer/shallow has been removed from react-test-renderer in React 19. Use the standalone 'react-shallow-renderer' package.

rules.title: react-dom/test-utils package has been deprecated and act moved to 'react'
rules.description: react-dom/test-utils has been deprecated in React 19 and act has moved to the core 'react' package.

rules.title: useFormState replaced by useActionState in React 19
rules.description: In React 19, useFormState from 'react-dom' is deprecated in favor of useActionState from 'react'.

remediation.summary: Replace useFormState from 'react-dom' with useActionState imported from 'react'.

rules.title: forwardRef is deprecated; ref is a standard prop on function components in React 19
rules.description: In React 19, function components can accept ref directly as a prop. forwardRef wrapper is deprecated and will be removed in future versions.

remediation.summary: Remove forwardRef wrapper and receive ref directly as a prop in component arguments.

rules.title: <Context.Provider> is deprecated in favor of rendering <Context> directly in React 19
rules.description: In React 19, you can render <Context value={...}> directly instead of <Context.Provider value={...}>.

remediation.summary: Render the Context object directly instead of using .Provider.

rules.title: useRef() requires an initial value argument in React 19
rules.description: In React 19 TypeScript typings, calling useRef() without arguments is deprecated and requires passing an initial value like useRef(null).

remediation.summary: Pass an explicit initial value such as null to useRef().

rules.title: react-test-renderer package is deprecated in React 19
rules.description: react-test-renderer is deprecated in React 19. Migrate your test suites to React Testing Library (@testing-library/react).
